summary: Management remotes for the layered stack must remain local-only.
notes: Cloud pushes are forbidden unless the human explicitly changes the rule.

summary: The project uses a mega repo plus child Git repos for client, live state, and server project layers.
notes: Nested source repos are also tracked by scan/map tools.

summary: The game client has a large untracked payload that is currently intentional.
notes: Full client tracking is blocked by disk capacity strategy.

summary: Generated scans, maps, manifests, and forensic reports are authoritative only after a fresh cycle.
notes: Stale generated evidence must be refreshed before high-risk action.

summary: Server runtime state is unknown until live probe and log intelligence are refreshed.
notes: Do not assume Docker or server processes are running.

summary: The AI system is a general local AI-OS control plane, not only a WoW project folder.
notes: WoW is the first managed project brain.

summary: Human authority remains above agents, tools, models, and governance.
The system supports pluggable human, Codex-like, GPT-like, research, observer, and governance agents.
notes: Agent registry defines roles and authority levels.

summary: The system can route work across coding, reasoning, research, diagnostics, and governance model classes.
notes: Model router is a contract for future runtime implementation.

summary: The system improves through institutional training, feedback, evaluation, and lessons, not model-weight training by default.
notes: Training folder defines curriculum and policy.

summary: The AI-OS can legally study public open-weight/open-source model families and self-hosted AI systems to extract architecture lessons.
notes: Claims remain source-labeled until reproduced or locally evaluated.

summary: The reconstructed AI target is a model-plus-tools-plus-memory-plus-runtime system, not a clone of any one public model.
notes: Target architecture turns extracted lessons into our own build roadmap.

summary: Contextual Work IQ is a required capability for choosing relevant memory, files, tools, risks, and verification paths.
notes: Context IQ reduces repeated work and context drift.
